label: neiso 58 offer surface
definition: (PROBE — winter scarcity charter Limb B; DORMANT, gates not met; keeper stays neiso-56.) The 2026-07-09-neiso-56-reserve-coopt keeper recipe + neiso_dynamic_reserve_requirements (Limb A, kept on) + neiso_offer_surface_conditional: the MEASURED ISO-NE fast-start DA offer surface — per-asset median top-of-curve heat-rate multipliers of the physics-selected fast-start population (Claim30 ≥ 0.9×EcoMax; ~110 masked assets, 1.78M asset-hours from 1,058 published train days), capacity-weighted into 5 equal-capacity rungs within pre-committed net-load-percentile bins (0.80/0.90/0.97), clamped ≥ the all-hours p50 (4.318× HR) — posted onto the CT_PEAKER peak-band rungs in the P1 bid objective (rule 13: measured offers conditioned on a forward-reproducible driver; prices validation-only; frozen per the pre-committed honesty gate). RESULT: the measured wall exists (top rungs 10.7–18.7× HR ≈ $310–550) but never price-sets — C3c tail unchanged (2025 1h vs DA 12h; the 1h is Limb A's RCPF hour), C5b unchanged (0.827 TWh), CT_PEAKER volume-neutral (≤0.0011 TWh/yr), monthly LMP Δ vs the surface-off arm ≈ $0 (max +$2.45 Nov-2024) — honesty-gate no-broad-elevation and volume-neutrality clauses PASS, charter gates C3c-2025 ∈[6,24]h and C5b-2025 ≥1.456 TWh NOT met. FINDING: in the 11 missed 2025 DA>$300 hours the model clears $256–272 (dual-fuel oil-parity region) or $82 (Jul 16 — not even tight): the real tail forms while the model still carries cheap non-fast-start headroom (CC/imports/oil-parity dual-fuel), so no fast-start repricing can reach it. Scores CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS with the identical caveat set as the keeper (C2 2025 gas commercial-band; C3c/C5b ledgered).
market_story: ISO-NE's fast-start fleet really does offer its top-of-curve far above cost in every condition bin — the measured wall is real market behaviour, kept in the bid objective per rule 1. It moves nothing here because the 2023–2025 NEISO stack never exhausts the cheaper capacity beneath it: the model's tight summer evenings clear on CC/import/oil-parity headroom at $256–272, below the wall's $310+ base. The zero-forcing twin repeats the neiso-57 signature (Limb A's June-2025 reserve-short hour binds deeper, 2h to $531, when the reliability floors' spare headroom is stripped).
